overview: Interactive masterclass on Special Relativity & Time Dilation

steps.title: Introduction to Special Relativity & Time Dilation
steps.teacher_script: Welcome to our deep dive into Step 1. Let us break down this concept from first principles. When we look at how this system operates, notice the fundamental relationship between each interacting component. Take a moment to inspect the visual breakdown on your whiteboard, and then we will test our intuition together.

visuals.title: Structural Flow: Step 1
visuals.content:
graph TD
  A[Input / Problem Definition] --> B[Processing & Transformation]
  B --> C[Optimization & Validation]
  C --> D[Target Solution Output]
visuals.explanation: Visualizing the end-to-end mechanism behind Step 1.

visuals.title: Intuitive Analogy
visuals.content: Think of this mechanism like a water purification system: raw data flows through multi-stage filters, where each stage isolates and transforms key properties until a pure, reliable result emerges.
visuals.explanation: Anchoring complex mechanics into everyday intuitive models.

visuals.title: Core Formula & Invariant
visuals.explanation: The fundamental mathematical relationship governing this process.

formative_question.prompt: Based on the mechanism of Step 1, what would happen if the primary input rate exceeds the processing threshold?
options: The system gracefully buffers or scales throughput accordingly
The entire pipeline immediately collapses with no recovery
The mathematical invariant reverses its sign completely
The process halts permanently until restarted manually
formative_question.correct_answer: The system gracefully buffers or scales throughput accordingly
hints: Think about standard engineering resilience mechanisms.
Consider how buffers absorb high transient loads.
common_misconceptions: Assuming systems immediately hard-crash without boundary controls.
